verdicts.reason: A squeezes the body copy into a narrow five-line ragged column, which reads badly. Its NEW FLAVOR badge is as large as the CTA, so the two compete for attention, and 'the Light' sits on a translucent circle. B's right column runs cleanly from headline to copy to CTA, but the big background circle is stretched into an ellipse, 'hour.' is orphaned on its own line, the logo is small and crowded under an oversized badge, and the can overlaps the edge of the ellipse.
